result.summary: Independent audit (attempt 1, r3, seed 807) written to audit_1.yaml. Slot a (E, core day_std(Ret), its final allowed E slot) passes novelty 4 / soundness 4; struck seeds 4 and 5 (the raw log-difference range-vs-realized-vol construction) because their raw correlation with the vol control is 0.872 and 0.796 respectively (seed4 auto-struck at >=0.8, seed5 struck manually as the same formula/failure mode at an adjacent window), while the regression-residual reformulation (seed 6, rho=0.059) was kept. 10/12 seeds remain. Operator semantics (cross_regbeta's y~alpha+beta*x, cs_last_high05/low05/high10/cs_first_high40 exclusion-screen docstrings) were verified against ops_ext.py and AlphaCube-steering's dt_cross.py/common.py source and matched the mission's claims. Slot b (N, limit-lock frequency via day_at_max_ratio/day_at_min_ratio/day_flat_ratio + LimitWidth) passes novelty 4 / soundness 4 with no seeds struck; confirmed via loc.md that these operators and a per-stock use of LimitWidth never appear in the 546-candidate archive. Deliberately did not strike the 5 seeds flagged gate=False in corr_1.json (low distinct_fraction/many ties) because that diagnostic (from partura/diagnose.py) matches exactly the 'ties broken by symbol order' scenario rules.md section 4 explicitly excludes as a valid objection -- this was noted in the reasons field rather than silently ignored or mechanically propagated. R group: both variant sets (window/depth cleanup of the +0.88 and +0.62 heads) scored soundness 5, cross-checked numerically against loc.md's dissection table (e.g. 0.878->0.83 knockout necessity +0.05, 0.878->1.47 window gain +0.59) and found accurate.
